authority.scope: current dedicated empirical target, ordered future targets, verification holds, and parked or closed troops
authority.rule: This file is the only repository source of truth for what troop should be tested next. Batch-local analysis/NEXT_TEST_RECOMMENDATION.md files and pull-request bodies are proposals and historical evidence only until the same merged pull request updates this file.

verification_holds.reason: The operator recalls that this troop may already have been tested. The repository contains incidental coverage and repeated next-test recommendations, but no authoritative global ledger previously resolved its final status.

parked.reason: No extraordinary empirical or structural hypothesis currently justifies spending dedicated battles merely to close its display gate.
No extraordinary empirical or structural hypothesis currently justifies additional dedicated battles.

update_contract.phase_1: May set or confirm active_test, but must not choose or reorder future targets from preliminary extraction.
update_contract.phase_2: Must update active_test, ordered_queue, verification_holds, and parked or closed entries in the same pull request whenever the completed analysis changes what should be tested next.
update_contract.historical_consolidation: A verification-hold consolidation must publish a bannerlord-consolidation-task:v1 comment and task path so the shared dispatcher can discover it without raw screenshots or a Phase 2 handoff.
update_contract.operator_decision: An explicit operator decision takes precedence and must be recorded in this file immediately.
update_contract.no_fallback: Never reconstruct the queue from chat memory, a pull-request title or body, or one batch-local NEXT_TEST_RECOMMENDATION.md while this file exists.
update_contract.empty_queue: An empty ordered_queue means no future target is approved yet; it does not authorize inventing a candidate.

closed.decision: Stop dedicated testing. Both exact participant field cohorts passed the 5-battle / 20-deployed gate and retained kill share above deployment share; the large Medger cohort remained positive after deleting its highest-rate battle.

Close dedicated field testing. Two compatible, battle-distinct committed sources provide 15 independent field battles / 192 deployed / 489 kills. The 11-battle source already clears the display gate independently, and the combined kill share remains above deployment share.

last_transition.reason: Historical consolidation recovered PR #91's compatible 11-battle reliable field aggregate and verified it is battle-distinct from PR #92's four-battle follow-up. No future target was selected.
